response.overview: A timid car-wash shop owner with a voyeuristic streak is preparing for the first date of his life when a menacing stranger walks in. Inside the sealed space of the car wash, his co-worker is murdered and the woman he secretly loves is in danger. As his fantasies of escape spiral, he sinks ever deeper into the mire - and a single gunshot on a black screen closes the film on its biggest question.
response.title: 刷车
